title: AC1024 TABLE source-pair triage
scope: Screen the public ACadSharp AC1024 sample and its paired DXFs as an implementation candidate for P5-D; do not change parser behavior or promote support.

producerEvidence.observedRoute: The script issues SAVEAS 2010 for sample_AC1024.dwg and separate SAVEAS 2010 ASCII and Binary DXF commands.
producerEvidence.limit: The exact execution application/build and the authoring provenance of the input sample_base.dwg are not established. Treat the pair as a source-triage candidate, not a native AutoCAD/ObjectARX semantic witness.

acquisition.method: Raw file from the public repository; compared against existing hash-bound local receipts and paired DXFs.
acquisition.repositoryPolicy: The third-party DWG/DXF pair remains outside this repository. No fixture was added.

observedProfile.formatBoundary: ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.96.2 states AC1024 DWG embeds TABLECONTENT in the ACAD_TABLE entity; the two standalone TABLECONTENT handles above are records in the paired DXF and are not asserted to be source DWG frame identities.

firstFailure.meaning: The current TABLECONTENT parser rejects the first ATTDEF handle role. ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.97 specifies a soft pointer for this field; the observed code is not accepted as a producer exception because preceding field/string/handle spans have not been reconciled.

result.strictOutput: Refused before output because standalone DWG OBJECTCONTEXTDATA has no qualified replay path; no DXF was produced.

conclusion: This pair is a useful bounded AC1024 TABLE/CELLSTYLEMAP candidate for local source-span reconciliation. It does not reproduce the reported AC1024 CLASSES failure, and it cannot close P5-D while the producer/build/API provenance, exact DWG field spans, graph closure, strict output, and native semantics remain unqualified.
next: Use the matching AC1024 ASCII/Binary DXFs to bind TABLE handle 0x528, TABLECONTENT/CELLSTYLEMAP identities, expected row/cell values, and the exact failing ATTDEF target.
Independently reconcile the AC1024 embedded TABLE body, R2007+ string intervals, and handle-stream start to ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.96.2/§20.4.97 before changing the parser or its expected handle role.

Keep raw-only/refusal behavior until the exact source profile parses without guessed offsets; then prove graph closure, selected ASCII/Binary output, fresh readback, refusal atomicity, and corrected retry.
Obtain AutoCAD/ObjectARX or equivalent independent producer/API provenance and native table appearance before closing P5-D.
